description: Build powerful OBS workflows visually. Trigger actions, sequence Move filters, change scenes, run actions simultaneously, and control timing from one workflow editor.

hero.title:
Make your OBS setup
workflows, not chains.
hero.intro: Move Workflow adds a workflow layer to OBS Studio. Move Transition performs the action; Move Workflow decides when it happens and what happens next.

features.title: Visual workflow editor
features.description: Build workflows by adding Trigger and Action nodes and connecting them together.

features.title: Move filter actions
features.description: Run existing Move Action, Move Source, Move Source Swap and Move Value filters.

features.title: Scene changes
features.description: Change the active OBS scene as part of a workflow.

features.title: Parallel actions
features.description: Start several actions together or continue to the next action after timing completes.

features.title: Precise timing
features.description: Give each action a Start Delay, Duration and End Delay.

features.title: Persistent workflows
features.description: Workflows are saved and restored when OBS starts.

features.title: Import and export
features.description: Move workflows between installations using .obsworkflow.json files.

requirements: OBS Studio 31.x or a compatible version supported by the build.
Exeldro's Move Transition plugin for Move actions.

setup.title: Get the plugin running.
setup.intro: Install the plugin, restart OBS, then open the workflow editor and create your first workflow.

steps.title: Download the plugin
steps.description: Download the Windows x64 package from the current release below.

steps.title: Install the plugin
steps.description: Extract the downloaded ZIP and copy the plugin files into your OBS plugins directory.

steps.title: Install Move Transition
steps.description: Install Exeldro's Move Transition plugin if you want to use Move actions in your workflows.

steps.title: Restart OBS
steps.description: Close and restart OBS Studio so the plugin is loaded.

steps.title: Open Move Workflow
steps.description: In OBS, open Tools > Move Workflow.

steps.title: Create a workflow
steps.description: Open the workflow manager and create a workflow with a useful name.

steps.title: Add a Trigger node
steps.description: Add a Trigger node and give it a name that describes what it starts, such as Start Intro or Show Camera.

steps.title: Add Action nodes
steps.description: Add the Move or Change Scene actions you need. Configure the target and timing for each action.

steps.title: Connect the nodes
steps.description: Connect nodes to decide which actions run together and which action runs next.

steps.title: Add a Trigger Workflow filter
steps.description: Add a Trigger Workflow filter to an OBS source and select the workflow and Trigger node that should start it.

steps.title: Test the workflow
steps.description: Activate the trigger and check the OBS log or enable Debug in the workflow editor if you need more information.

notes: Move Workflow does not replace Move Transition. Move Transition performs the actual Move operation; Move Workflow controls sequencing.
Easing and Easing Function are shown in workflow data for future use but are not implemented in 1.0.0.
